grammar.title: The Imperfect Subjunctive (Congiuntivo Imperfetto) in Cultural Discussions
grammar.explanation: The imperfect subjunctive is used in subordinate clauses when the main verb is in the past or conditional: 'Credevo che fosse un bel film' (I thought it was a good film). It is formed from the imperfect stem: -are -> -assi, -assi, -asse, -assimo, -aste, -assero; -ere -> -essi, -essi, -esse, -essimo, -este, -essero; -ire -> -issi, -issi, -isse, -issimo, -iste, -issero. Essere: fossi, fossi, fosse, fossimo, foste, fossero. This tense is essential for expressing hypothetical opinions about art and culture.
